name: OverHedgeV2
summary: OverHedgeV2 is a hedging EA that opens opposite-direction positions to protect existing trades when the market moves against them. It manages overlapping hedge orders to reduce overall exposure and attempts to close hedged positions at breakeven or small profit. The EA is designed for traders who want automated risk offset rather than manual stop-loss placement.
summary_zh: OverHedgeV2是一个对冲型EA，当市场走势对现有持仓不利时，自动开立反向仓位以保护已有交易。它管理重叠的对冲订单以降低整体敞口，并尝试在保本或小幅盈利时平仓。该EA面向希望自动对冲风险而非手动设置止损的交易者。
strategy_analysis: OverHedgeV2的策略核心是对冲(hedging)，即在现有亏损仓位的基础上开立反向仓位来锁定浮亏防止进一步扩大。入场条件是当已有持仓浮亏达到设定的阈值时，EA自动开立等量或倍量的反向对冲单。出场条件通常设定为当对冲组合的整体盈亏达到保本或目标利润时，同时平掉正反两个方向的仓位。仓位管理方面，EA可能支持加码对冲(即浮亏继续扩大时增加对冲手数)，这与马丁格尔有相似之处但本质不同——目的是锁定而非翻本。资金管理依赖于初始手数和对冲比例参数，但没有严格的净值百分比风控。整体来看，该策略适合震荡行情，但在单边强趋势中可能因不断加对冲而耗尽保证金。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of OverHedgeV2 is hedging — opening opposite-direction positions against existing losing trades to lock in floating losses and prevent further drawdown. Entry conditions trigger when an existing position's floating loss exceeds a configured threshold, at which point the EA automatically opens a reverse hedge order of equal or multiplied volume. Exit conditions are typically set to close both the original and hedge positions simultaneously when the combined profit/loss of the hedged pair reaches breakeven or a target profit level. Position sizing may support incremental hedging (adding hedge volume as losses deepen), which resembles martingale in mechanics but differs in purpose — the goal is exposure lockdown rather than recovery through doubling. Money management relies on initial lot size and hedge ratio parameters but lacks strict equity percentage risk controls. The strategy suits ranging markets but risks margin exhaustion in strong trending conditions where repeated hedging can accumulate large exposure.

parameters.name: HedgeStartPips
parameters.description: 开始对冲的浮亏点数阈值
parameters.description_en: Floating loss threshold in pips to start hedging

parameters.name: HedgeLotMultiplier
parameters.description: 对冲手数倍率，1.0为等量对冲
parameters.description_en: Hedge lot multiplier; 1.0 for equal hedging

parameters.name: TakeProfitPips
parameters.description: 对冲组合的目标盈利点数
parameters.description_en: Hedge combo target profit in pips

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号用于标识订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number; 0 manages all positions

pros: 自动化对冲机制减少人工干预，适合无法时刻盯盘的交易者
对冲组合平仓逻辑可以在震荡行情中实现保本退出，避免止损硬亏
支持多层对冲和手数倍率参数，灵活性较高，适应不同风险偏好
相比纯马丁格尔策略，对冲策略的出发点是风控保护而非赌博翻本
pros_en: Automated hedging reduces manual intervention, suitable for traders who cannot monitor charts constantly
Combined hedged position closing logic can achieve breakeven exits in ranging markets, avoiding hard stop-loss losses
Supports multi-level hedging and lot multiplier parameters with good flexibility for different risk preferences
Unlike pure martingale, hedging strategy originates from risk control protection rather than gambling recovery
cons: 在单边趋势行情中，多层对冲可能导致持仓量急剧膨胀，保证金风险极高
缺乏全局止损机制，如果对冲组合持续恶化，账户可能被强制平仓
对冲本质上并未消除风险，只是延后了亏损实现的时间，可能造成更大损失
参数敏感性强，HedgeLotMultiplier和MaxHedgeLevels设置不当会迅速放大风险
cons_en: In strong trending markets, multi-level hedging can cause position sizes to explode, creating extreme margin risk
Lacks a global stop-loss mechanism; if the hedge combination deteriorates continuously, the account may face margin call
Hedging does not eliminate risk — it merely delays loss realization, potentially leading to larger eventual losses
High parameter sensitivity; improper HedgeLotMultiplier and MaxHedgeLevels settings can rapidly amplify risk
improvements: 添加账户净值百分比的全局止损机制，当总浮亏超过净值一定比例时强制平所有仓位
增加趋势过滤指标(如ADX或均线方向)，在强趋势行情中暂停对冲操作以避免无限叠加
实现对冲仓位的智能追踪止盈，而非固定点数目标，提高盈利效率
improvements_en: Add a global stop-loss based on account equity percentage, forcing closure of all positions when total floating loss exceeds a threshold
Implement a trend filter indicator (e.g., ADX or moving average direction) to pause hedging in strong trending markets and avoid infinite stacking
Implement intelligent trailing take-profit for hedged positions instead of fixed pip targets to improve profit efficiency

risk_points: 多层对冲在单边趋势中可能无限叠加仓位，保证金风险极高
缺少全局止损或最大回撤保护，账户可能遭受灾难性损失
对冲手数倍率大于1时实质上接近马丁格尔的风险特征
risk_points_en: Multi-level hedging can stack positions infinitely in trending markets, creating extreme margin risk
Lacks global stop-loss or maximum drawdown protection; account could suffer catastrophic losses
Hedge lot multiplier greater than 1 effectively approaches martingale risk characteristics

It manages overlapping hedge orders to reduce overall exposure and attempts to close hedged positions at breakeven or small profit. The EA is designed for traders who want automated risk offset rather than manual stop-loss placement.
